entries.title: Metro 2033

primary.why: Metro 2033 released on Windows and Xbox 360, then Metro 2033 Redux rebuilt it for modern platforms with updated technology and later reached Linux, macOS, Switch, and Stadia. Windows Redux is the highest-fidelity archive route because the PC Redux version has the best capture/settings ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Use Metro 2033 Redux on Windows. Use the original Windows release only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Redux changes presentation and mechanics; use original only for comparison.

entries.title: Metro: Last Light
entries.definitive_edition: Metro: Last Light Redux on Windows

primary.why: Metro: Last Light released on Windows, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, OS X, and Linux, then Redux released across modern platforms and later Switch and Stadia. Redux is the improved/remastered PC route, making Windows Redux the best archive version.
primary.how_to_play: Use Metro: Last Light Redux on Windows. Use the original only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Redux is the preferred route; original remains historical comparison.

entries.title: Metro Exodus
entries.definitive_edition: Metro Exodus Enhanced Edition on Windows with both DLC expansions

primary.version: Metro Exodus Enhanced Edition with both DLC expansions
primary.why: Metro Exodus released on PlayStation 4, Windows, Xbox One, Stadia, Linux, and macOS, then received Enhanced Edition releases on Windows, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. Windows Enhanced Edition is the fidelity route and supports the full package with The Two Colonels and Sam's Story.
primary.how_to_play: Use Metro Exodus Enhanced Edition on Windows with The Two Colonels and Sam's Story installed. Ensure the GPU supports the Enhanced Edition requirements.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition requires compatible ray-tracing hardware; original PC route remains fallback if hardware support fails.

entries.title: Metro Awakening

emulation.notes: Native PC VR; headset and GPU choice define fidelity ceiling.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: High-end PC VR headset on Windows

primary.why: Metro Awakening is a VR prequel released for Meta Quest 2/3, PlayStation VR2, SteamVR, and Viveport. PC VR is the highest-fidelity archive route when headset and GPU are available, while Quest is the standalone convenience route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC VR/SteamVR version with the best available headset and GPU. Use Quest only if standalone capture is the goal.

entries.remaster_caveats: VR-only spin-off/prequel, not the next mainline non-VR Metro game.

primary.platform: Unreleased - Windows / PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X/S announced
primary.why: Metro 2039 is an upcoming title for Windows, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S with a February 2027 window. Best-version and completeness claims must wait until release builds and edition details can be verified.
primary.how_to_play: Do not archive a play route until the game ships and final platform behavior is verified.
